answer: Every new identity pays a registration fee into an ivory bounty pool. At the dawn of each epoch the network publishes a marble ledger of the pool, and any hunter who proves a puppet cluster with on-chain evidence claims a cut scaled to the cluster size. A Sybil farmer thus pays into the fund that rewards his own exposers: each puppet raises the bounty on its own head, detection compounds across epochs, and the farm subsidizes the hunt against itself. Honest users pay once; attackers pay per puppet and fund their own ruin.
